data.one_liner: Custom side menu and drawer implementation with zoom and rotation animations
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable side menu drawer widget that supports sliding animations, rotation, shadows, scaling, and both LTR and RTL layouts. It can be controlled via a dedicated controller or static context methods.
use_when: You want a modern sliding drawer with zoom, shadow, or rotation effects.
You need support for both LTR and RTL layouts in your side menu.
avoid_when: You only need the standard Material Design Scaffold endDrawer/drawer.
You require a complex nested navigation architecture handled entirely by a routing library.
strengths: Supports multiple visual styles, shadows, and rotation effects
Works across multiple platforms including web
Provides both controller and static context access methods
weaknesses: Custom drawer styles may have breaking changes across major version updates
data.minimal_example:
ZoomDrawer(
  controller: ZoomDrawerController(),
  menuScreen: MenuScreen(),
  mainScreen: MainScreen(),
  borderRadius: 24.0,
  showShadow: true,
  angle: -12.0,
  slideWidth: 275.0,
)
